name: Inland Homes plc
summary: Inland Homes plc operates as a real estate development company in the United Kingdom. It develops brownfield projects. The company is also involved in the provision of finance; construction of domestic buildings; and letting or operating of real estate properties. It holds a land portfolio of 11,045 plots, as well as 1,302 partnership homes and 415 private homes under construction. The company was formerly known as Inland PLC and changed its name to Inland Homes plc in November 2011. Inland Homes plc was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Beaconsfield, the United Kingdom.
